bio: Matt Denton grew up in small-town Tennessee and moved to New York City in 2009 during the U.S. dance-music boom. He started DJing after a friend encouraged him to share his music library, and his first-ever DJ set was at Burning Man around 2013 — an experience he has described as reconnecting him with his inner child. He is a key figure in The GlamCocks, a DJ collective that grew out of a Burning Man sunset-party camp into a multi-city party production crew across NYC, Fire Island Pines, LA, San Francisco, and DC.
burning_man_history: First-ever DJ set was at Burning Man circa 2013; key figure of The GlamCocks, a DJ collective that originated as a Burning Man camp hosting sunset parties around 2013 before expanding into a multi-city party crew.

bio: Stephan May is a house/melodic-techno DJ and producer based between Los Angeles and New York who has performed internationally, including Mexico City, Barcelona, Portugal, and Beats for Love in the Czech Republic. His sets blend house, melodic, and techno elements.
notable_releases: "Save Me" (with Monblaire Music, part of the Chromatics III EP on weareanims); "Lately" (single, released March 27)

bio: Artemistique (Ayça) is a downtempo/organic-electronic DJ whose debut mixtape, shared on SoundCloud as "First Light" / "Where It Begins," was recorded following DJ nights in Paris and blends soulful house grooves with jazzy, spacey textures.

DJ Zilkha (real name Shahar) is a DJ and producer from Israel who is part of the Spinnin' Records Talent Pool. He is known for remixes of tracks by artists including Avicii, Meduza, Tones and I, and SAINt JHN.

Kon Faber is an electronic live duo based in Berlin who transform images, scenes, and emotions from their surroundings into cross-genre "acoustic mosaics." They run their own label, KONVERGE, and have toured Mexico, Australia, New Zealand, and cities including New York, Amsterdam, Tunis, London, Milan, and Berlin.
notable_releases: Kein Stress w/ Sanoi & Vokalmatador (KONVERGE004); Percolate EP (ELEMENTS); Dawn EP (KONVERGE003); Hooked (KONVERGE002); And You EP with JAVID (KONVERGE001); The Tamer (Rummel ES / Panorama compilation)
labels: KONVERGE (own label); also released on A Tribe Called Kotori, Kamai, Saisons, Rebellion der Träumer, ELEMENTS
notable_collaborations: JAVID; KOYENGA (formerly LADS); Sanoi; Vokalmatador; Iorie (remixer)

bio: Lola Jak is a dance-music duo based in Portland, Oregon, that describes itself as being "in search of frisson."

MNTRA is a drum-and-bass-rooted producer and DJ based in Berkeley, California, described as a pioneer of a distinctive West Coast underground sound built around unreleased tracks and emotional themes.
notable_releases: Hey, How Are You? (album, June 2024, feat. Victoria Rae, NOZU, AiDO, Mitsuø, and dernis, the kid); Waiting (album, Feb 2024); "On Your Side" (Space Song Remix, Sept 2025); "Justice - D.A.N.C.E (MNTRA Remix)" (Feb 2026)
notable_collaborations: Victoria Rae; NOZU; AiDO; Mitsuø; dernis, the kid

bio: SAGMO is a DJ/producer based in San Francisco, CA, active in the local house scene and a frequent B2B partner of fellow SF-area DJ Matony, including a joint direct-support set for Adam Ten at The Great Northern in San Francisco (July 2023).

Matony is a tech-house/melodic-house DJ and producer active in the Sacramento/San Francisco Bay Area scene, and a frequent B2B partner of fellow DJ SAGMO — the two have shared bills including direct support for Adam Ten at The Great Northern in San Francisco (July 2023) and the Dusty Disco event alongside Izik, Goma, and Marie Posa (Sept 2023).

Ahau is a Chilean organic-electronic/world-fusion producer who grew up near the Andean rainforest in southern Chile, an upbringing that shaped his fusion of natural/ancestral sounds with dance music. His album Explorasol (2023) was recorded partly with sounds captured in the Peruvian Amazon and is dedicated to the native community of Paoyhán, with music delivered in support of the NGO Alianza Arkana.
notable_releases: Explorasol (album, March 2023); YoSoY (May 2024); "Bad Bunny - DtMF (Ahau & Muluk Edit)" (March 2025); "Mantra Espontáneo" (Original Mix, Oct 2020)

bio: Mona Pirzad is a Berlin-based DJ who spent a decade as an actress before moving into music; she describes discovering that her ability to empathize translated well into DJing. Her sound blends Berlin's deep-house aesthetic with Persian cultural influences.

Mr. Bold is a Chicago-house-rooted DJ, originally from Chicago and now based in San Diego, who has been playing Chicago and tech house for over 30 years. He grew up amid the early Chicago house scene, citing influences including Bad Boy Bill, Farley "Jackmaster" Funk, Julian "Jumpin'" Perez, Frankie Knuckles, Mike Dunn, Marshall Jefferson, Derrick Carter, and Cajmere aka Green Velvet, and frequented venues like The Warehouse, Shelter, Crobar, and Gramaphone Records. He is a regular co-billed collaborator with DJ Senzø at Belly Up Tavern in Solana Beach, CA.

notable_releases: "Set Me Free" (Quantify feat. VLVT // PLSE, released via Quantify Music's SoundCloud)

bio: Rampue is a Berlin-based DJ, live act, and producer central to the city's slow-house/melodic-techno scene, closely associated with venues like Kater Blau. He began producing as a kid using the PlayStation program "Music 2000," inspired by his older brother, and has released on A Tribe Called Kotori, Audiolith, and URSL, with tracks including "Sonne Park und Sterni," "Bubblebath Trance," and "Harmonie / Inside."
labels: A Tribe Called Kotori; Audiolith; URSL
burning_man_history: Played Robot Heart at Burning Man 2015, released by Robot Heart itself as "Rampue - Live At Robot Heart - Burning Man 2015" on SoundCloud/Mixcloud; returned to Burning Man in 2025 for a joint Mayan Warrior & Robot Heart live set, per a YouTube upload titled "RAMPUE - Mayan Warrior & Robot Heart link up - Burning Man 2025."

bio: Sensanik is a vinyl-trained DJ/producer with 15 years of studio experience, associated with Bali, Indonesia, whose sound blends deep drums, hypnotic grooves, techno rhythms, and soulful melodies. He has released on UnderYourSkin Records (Berlin), Atlantic Records, Get Physical Music, Mobilee Records, and Tierra Sounds, and remixed two tracks from Sia's 2024 album Reasonable Woman.
notable_releases: Remixes of two tracks from Sia's Reasonable Woman (2024)
labels: UnderYourSkin Records; Atlantic Records; Get Physical Music; Mobilee Records; Tierra Sounds
burning_man_history: Artist's own website lists Robot Heart (Burning Man) among his key venues and notes a Burning Man appearance on the Eden Art Car dated September 1 (2024).
